english_text: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report; if there is any virtue, and if there is any praise, think about these things.
english:
Focus your mind on what is true, honorable, just, pure, and beautiful.
Seek out what is commendable and virtuous in every situation.
Let these positive thoughts guide your daily life.
spanish:
Enfoca tu mente en lo que es verdadero, honorable, justo, puro y hermoso.
Busca lo que es encomiable y virtuoso en cada situación.
Deja que estos pensamientos positivos guíen tu vida diaria.
portuguese:
Concentre sua mente no que é verdadeiro, honroso, justo, puro e belo.
Procure o que é louvável e virtuoso em cada situação.
Deixe que esses pensamentos positivos guiem sua vida diária.
french:
Concentrez votre esprit sur ce qui est vrai, honorable, juste, pur et beau.
Recherchez ce qui est louable et vertueux dans chaque situation.
Laissez ces pensées positives guider votre quotidien.
tagalog:
Ituon ang iyong isip sa mga bagay na totoo, kagalang-galang, makatarungan, dalisay, at maganda.
Hanapin ang mga kapuri-puri at mabuting asal sa bawat sitwasyon.
Hayaan ang mga positibong pag-iisip na ito ang maggabay sa iyong pang-araw-araw na buhay.
swahili:
Zingatia mawazo yako kwa yale ambayo ni ya kweli, ya heshima, ya haki, safi, na mazuri.
Tafuta kile kinachostahili pongezi na kinachojenga tabia njema katika kila hali.
Acha mawazo haya chanya yaongoze maisha yako ya kila siku.
mandarin_chinese:
专注于真实、光荣、公正、纯洁和美好的事物。
在每种情境中寻找值得赞扬和有美德的事物。
让这些积极的想法指引你的日常生活。
russian:
Сосредоточь свой ум на том, что истинно, достойно, справедливо, чисто и прекрасно.
Ищи то, что заслуживает похвалы и добродетели в каждой ситуации.
Позволь этим позитивным мыслям направлять твою повседневную жизнь.
malayalam:
സത്യം, മാന്യത, നീതി, ശുദ്ധി, സുന്ദര്യം എന്നിവയിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ മനസ്സ് കേന്ദ്രീകരിക്കുക.
ഓരോ സാഹചര്യത്തിലും പ്രശംസനീയവും ഗുണവത്തുമുള്ളതിനെ തേടുക.
ഈ സാന്ദ്രമായ ചിന്തകൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈനംദിന ജീവിതത്തെ നയിക്കട്ടെ.
